The '''Shirb system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Located on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth]] and [[Shaum Hii system/Legends|Shaum Hii systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> it contained<ref name="BoFetPracMan" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|374|New Holgha}}</ref> [[New Holgha]].<ref name="BoFetPracMan" />

New Holgha was [[Battle of New Holgha|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="BoFetPracMan" /> in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Boba Fett]], [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]], under the guise of aiding the Yuuzhan Vong in their conquest on the planet, traveled to the Shirb system. However, he turned on the invaders and encountered [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]], whom Fett enlisted in funneling intelligence to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after it had failed to protect the world.<ref name="BoFetPracMan" /> Subsequently, the system fell under the rule of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shirb system made its first appearance in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="BoFetPracMan" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
